description: Delete an organisation (CRM account) of the ACTIVE tenant. Always parked for human approval first (returns pending_approval + a preview: tenant ids and links). Refused while the account still has linked contacts, leads, offers, contracts, invoices, emails, documents, deadlines, subsidiaries etc. — the error lists them; for a duplicate use merge_records entity=account instead. Notes, AI memory, labels and custom field values are deleted with it. A full snapshot goes to the audit log (list_audit_log / list_record_history) for manual recovery.

account_id.description: ID of the account (company) to delete

reason.description: Why it is deleted (stored in the audit log), e.g. 'Dublette, im falschen Mandanten angelegt'.

name: delete_account
